stories.title: India core sector output hits 10.9 percent
stories.summary: India's core infrastructure output grew 10.9 percent in October, the fastest pace in the current series. Double-digit gains in coal, electricity, iron ore and cement production offset declines in natural gas, crude oil and fertiliser. The sector previously expanded by 8.2 percent in September 2026.

stories.title: India forex reserves drop by 14.2 billion dollars
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by 14.21 billion dollars to 705.34 billion dollars for the week ending November 13. The Reserve Bank of India attributed the decline to falling gold reserves and foreign currency assets. The total reserves stood at 719.55 billion dollars the previous week.

stories.title: India GDP growth outlook remains at 7 percent
stories.summary: India's GDP growth is expected to hold around 7 percent in 2027, according to the Amundi Investment Institute. The report warns that rising energy prices, a widening current account deficit and inflation could force the Reserve Bank of India to raise interest rates soon.

stories.title: Indian agfoodtech funding reaches 701 million dollars
stories.summary: India's agfoodtech sector secured over 701 million dollars across 185 deals in 2025, according to ThinkAg. While FoodTech capital flows rose 20 percent, total deal counts and values have plateaued as investors shift focus toward established players. The sector remains within a narrow three-year funding band.

stories.title: Capital goods market projected to reach 1.2 trillion dollars
stories.summary: India's capital goods market could grow to 1.2 trillion dollars by 2047, according to the Confederation of Indian Industry and Boston Consulting Group. Annual capital expenditure in electronics, semiconductors and data centres is projected to quadruple by 2029, making it the fastest-growing segment in the industry.

stories.title: PIDG invests in waste management firm NEPRA
stories.summary: Private Infrastructure Development Group has committed 110 crore rupees to Aavishkaar-backed NEPRA. The company describes itself as India’s largest dry waste recycling firm, integrating collection and recovery activities that are often fragmented. This marks the group's first equity investment in the Asian waste-management sector.

stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks reached nine-month closing highs on November 20, with the Sensex rising 898 points. Markets defied a global rout as investors rotated funds away from artificial intelligence-linked stocks and into Indian equities, supported by record foreign portfolio inflows and lower crude oil prices.

stories.title: Indian stock markets end higher
stories.summary: Sensex rose 897.96 points to 83,919.71, while Nifty 50 gained 286.30 points to 25,800.60. Banking stocks led the rally, while IT stocks saw buying interest despite a global technology sell-off. Foreign investors continue to pump money into Indian stocks. The market appears to have its own trajectory.

stories.title: US tech stocks enter bear market
stories.summary: Shares in Anthropic and Nvidia fell sharply this week, marking the worst performance for the sector since the Covid-19 crisis. Investors are reassessing the sustainability of the artificial intelligence spending boom, leading to a broad sell-off across Wall Street technology firms.

stories.title: Wall Street Nears Breaking Point as Fear Grips Global Markets - Bloomberg.com
Nvidia faces SEC accounting probe amid sell-off
stories.summary: Nvidia shares dropped 14.01 percent on Friday to close at $125.53. The decline followed reports of a Securities and Exchange Commission accounting investigation into the chipmaker. The probe adds to investor skepticism regarding elevated valuations and financial risks across the broader semiconductor industry.

stories.title: Wall Street loses confidence in AI sector
stories.summary: Trillions of dollars in market value were erased from the US share market on Friday as investors retreated from big tech. The Nasdaq composite is now in the red for 2026. Nvidia shares fell 12.8 percent, marking seven consecutive weeks of losses for the chipmaker.

stories.title: Tech stocks lead Wall Street bloodbath as S&P 500 posts massive weekly loss
stories.summary: Wall Street’s major averages plummeted lower on Friday and finished deep in the red as the tech selloff intensified. US stocks enter correction as AI rally falters
stories.summary: The S&P 500 and the Dow have entered a correction, falling more than 10% below their record highs. The decline followed Anthropic's market debut and marked the S&P 500's longest losing streak since February 2020. The AI trade that defined this year's market rally is currently being reconsidered.

stories.title: SEBI proposes tenure caps for market institution heads
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has proposed limiting managing directors of stock exchanges and depositories to two terms and eight years within a single institution, with a 12-year overall limit. The regulator noted that individuals heading multiple institutions may exert a disproportionate influence over the ecosystem.

stories.title: India proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
stories.summary: India's markets regulator on Friday proposed reducing the age limit for public interest directors at exchanges and depositories to 70 from 75, as part of a broader governance overhaul for key market institutions. The Securities and Exchange Board of India also proposed to limit tenures of heads of these market

stories.title: SEBI considers easing disclosure rules for foreign funds
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has proposed eliminating granular disclosure requirements for foreign portfolio investors. The regulator stated that these norms, which mandate details on all underlying owners for certain funds, are unique to India and have acted as an entry barrier for overseas capital.

stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) plans to further ease compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), including removing certain conditions that are not prevalent in other major markets, Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said on Friday. The regulator will soon issue a consultation paper on simplifying FPI operations,

stories.title: CBI, Bancomat and Nexi to build Italian digital euro infrastructure
stories.summary: CBI, Bancomat and Nexi have formed a partnership to develop the infrastructure required to support the potential arrival of a digital euro in Italy. The project aims to establish the necessary technical framework for the currency's future integration.

stories.title: Adyen adds Klarna to AI agent checkout
stories.summary: Adyen and Klarna have announced that shoppers can now use Klarna as a payment method when an AI agent completes a transaction through Adyen Agentic. The integration allows automated assistants to process payments using the finance network's services.

stories.title: Aqua Global and IntellectEU partner on digital asset connectivity
stories.summary: Aqua Global and IntellectEU are working together to help banks connect their existing payment operations to digital asset networks. The partnership aims to bridge the gap between legacy banking infrastructure and the newer digital asset ecosystem.

stories.title: Curvestone AI launches automated compliance monitoring
stories.summary: Curvestone AI has launched financial promotions and website monitoring for regulated advice firms. The platform aims to automate oversight for entities ranging from mortgage networks to wealth managers, promising to handle compliance tasks for firms of every size.

stories.title: Maybank completes first tokenised MGS transaction
stories.summary: Maybank has executed Malaysia’s first tokenised Malaysian Government Securities transaction. The pilot, conducted with its insurance arm Etiqa, marks a milestone for the bank’s initiative under the Bank Negara Malaysia Digital Asset Innovation Hub.

stories.title: Jamtara police arrest four in UPI cashback fraud scheme
stories.summary: Authorities in Jamtara have arrested four individuals accused of running a fraud scheme involving fake UPI cashback offers and malware. Police seized eight mobile phones and 13 SIM cards during the operation. Two of the suspects had prior convictions for similar online fraud.

stories.title: EPFO reduces waiting period for final withdrawal
stories.summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation has reduced the waiting period for final provident fund withdrawals after unemployment from 12 months to two months. The decision reverses a change implemented in October 2025, granting members faster access to their retirement savings.

stories.title: Analysis suggests market timing offers little SIP advantage
stories.summary: A WhiteOak Capital Mutual Fund analysis of 30 years of Sensex data suggests that starting a systematic investment plan at market bottoms provides only marginal gains over starting at peaks. Waiting for a market correction often results in missing years of potential investment growth.

stories.title: Tribunal clarifies gold jewellery limits during tax searches
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted a tax addition after gold jewellery was found at a taxpayer's home, accepting that the items were within reasonable family limits. The ruling notes that while traditional accumulation is recognised, it does not exempt taxpayers from explaining the source.

stories.title: Tax department issues guidance on foreign asset disclosures
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department has released 43 supplementary FAQs under the FAST-DS 2026 scheme. The guidance clarifies compliance requirements for foreign bank accounts, joint ownership and valuation of overseas assets, noting that certain omissions may qualify for relief under specific conditions.

stories.title: NPS investors weigh active versus auto choice strategies
stories.summary: Investors in the National Pension System are choosing between Active Choice, which allows for higher equity exposure, and Auto Choice, which reduces risk as the investor ages. The decision impacts the potential retirement corpus over long investment horizons, balancing wealth creation against market volatility.

stories.title: Department of Posts updates savings bank manual
stories.summary: The Department of Posts has released the 2026 Core Banking Solution manual, consolidating rules for savings accounts. The update covers procedures for minimum balances, dormant accounts, transfer fees and death claims, aiming to standardise regulations across the postal savings network.

stories.title: Banks offer credit limit increases to customers
stories.summary: Financial institutions are sending offers to increase credit card limits, citing potential benefits like financial flexibility and improved credit scores. Experts suggest that accepting these offers without careful consideration can lead to overspending and an increased debt burden.

stories.title: MCA proposes NFRA recruitment changes
stories.summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has proposed extending the maximum deputation tenure for National Financial Reporting Authority officers from five to seven years. The plan also includes revising experience requirements for senior roles and increasing the promotion quota for manager positions. The authority is looking for more time.

stories.title: Joint holders must disclose foreign bank accounts separately
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department has clarified that all joint holders of a foreign bank account must disclose holdings separately under the FAST-DS 2026 scheme. This applies even if one person funded the account. The department will divide the account value among holders based on their respective shares.

stories.title: I-T department clarifies foreign account disclosure exemptions
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department stated that foreign bank accounts with an aggregate balance up to 20 lakh rupees are exempt from non-disclosure penalties if funds are sourced from disclosed income. These accounts are also exempt from prosecution under the Black Money Act. Disclosure remains optional for these specific holdings.

stories.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individual service exporters
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified that resident individuals exporting services are exempt from filing export declaration forms. Non-individual exporters must submit the form only when inward remittances exceed 10 lakh rupees. The change aims to reduce compliance burdens for smaller service exporters.

stories.title: Income tax department releases FAST-DS FAQs
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department has issued supplementary guidance for the FAST-DS 2026 scheme regarding overseas assets omitted from tax returns. The clarifications address valuation of property, joint account holdings and eligibility for returning non-residents. Taxpayers are advised to review the points before using the scheme.

stories.title: RBI clarifies forex reporting for service trade
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified that the 10 lakh rupee threshold for service export reporting applies to individual inward remittances rather than aggregate receipts. The central bank previously exempted resident individuals from declaration requirements. The rules follow questions regarding the scope of recent foreign exchange regulations.

However, public planners generally are also concerned with mitigating risk and, more generally, uncertainty and ambiguity. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Interpreting the Morbidity Gap
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study now reports the morbidity gap (MG), life expectancy minus healthy life expectancy, as an indicator in its own right. Writing MG as the expected cumulative rate of years lived. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Multiscale Reconstruction of Weighted Networks from Coarse-Grained Data
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Network reconstruction from partial information is usually performed at the same resolution level at which constraints are observable. This becomes problematic when only coarse-grained information is available, while the relevant process occurs at a finer scale. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

We study the kernel of domestic intermediate transactions, the part that rescaling to new industry totals cannot update. Among 25 economies with a national table every. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
